_comment: Generated by mono.tools/bindings. Do not edit by hand.
What a script can name and what each name costs, taken from the class
table rather than restated beside it. A change here is a change to the
scripting surface, and reviewing the diff is reviewing that change.
Every identity is a string. There are no byte offsets and no component
ids, because a property is a conversion rather than a field at an
address -- so nothing here goes stale when a struct is reordered or a
subdirectory moves in the link line.
'reads' and 'writes' are what a getter needs and what a setter
touches. Size writes two components; that is not a mistake.
